notes.title: Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths — Dev Diary #97
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello, Truck Mechanics![/b][/h1]

It's been a while since we last got in touch, but now we're back with a massive update for Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths, and trust us – it's been worth the wait! We've packed in a ton of new features, interactions, and systems to keep you busy on the perilous roads... Let's dive right in!

[previewyoutube=phI9LPvF1gY;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

[b]New Interactions[/b]

We've significantly expanded the range of uses and interactions for your tools. You can now open and repair gates and signs, or even demolish blockades using your trusty machete. You can also pick up new objects such as cash, skill books that grant free skill unlocks, and customization items. Additionally, the bolt cutters are now useful for slicing through certain fences, while the winch can be used to break down terrain obstacles. And that's not all – keep an eye out for paint buckets scattered around in-game locales to alter your truck's color scheme and give it a fresh new look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/ce1dd50ad883d88f2b69907d44f0e6fb25c62c6b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

[b] New Reputation System [/b]

With so many new interactions, we've also revamped the reputation system. To progress through certain missions, you'll now need to attain specific reputation levels. And how do you do that? By completing side quests, cargo deliveries, and smaller tasks that earn you reputation points. It's time to step up and prove your worth!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/f110099cf8d0fd40e42dd3f3fc50a4135fc3a15d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

[b] Skill System [/b]

Finally, the long-awaited skill system is here! We've introduced 4 distinct skill categories: Driving, Mechanics, Exploration, and Economy. Each skill can be purchased with the cash you've collected or, as mentioned earlier, by finding special skill books hidden throughout the world. Unlock them to gain a strategic edge and further tailor your playstyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/16d9af3a8504fe235c5804270d98d353c9cdbf0f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

[b]Misc Changes[/b]

In addition to these major inclusions, we've revised the tutorial system to make it clearer and more informative, ensuring that every newcomer knows the ropes. We've also introduced a guidebook where you can revisit essential mechanics or view gameplay tips at any time. Not to mention, the game now has full controller support, updated UI, and numerous other quality-of-life improvements to make your journey smoother than ever before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/26dc916097af06ce7d277c4191faa68e5dbc4ae1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates and keep on trucking! If you like what you see, consider adding Truck Mechanic to your Steam Wishlist!

[b]Wishlist the game on Steam :)[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/995680/Truck_Mechanic_Dangerous_Paths/

[b]Join our Discord community[/b]
[url=https://discord.gg/xhQmGdqBu4]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/5d6362c1cbd78392fa405b5a32687a30f5984fc8.png[/img][/url]

Happy wrenching!

Yours truly,
Atomic Jelly

notes.title: Start Your Adventure!
notes.content:
Hello, Truck Mechanics!

Next Fest has started on Steam and will last until March 3. We are proud to announce that Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths will take part in the festival and for this reason have prepared a completely new demo! Now is a great opportunity to get acquainted with the game, and those who have already played the previous version are welcome to check on the title's progress!

A newcomer or not, this is your chance to dive into the action!

So, what awaits you in the demo?
[list][*] Several Initial Missions: Go on a journey along the roads and the rugged terrain of a wild jungle.
[*] Realistic Breakdowns: Encounter authentic breakdowns as you drive, adding an element of challenge and strategy to your every trip.
[*] Extensive Repair Options: Access five specialized truck zones and utilize two repair tables for some hands-on fixes.
[*] Dynamic Day/Night Cycle: Experience the changing environment as you travel during different times of day.
[*] Variable Weather Conditions: Face the elements with realistic weather effects that will put your skills to the test!
[*] In-depth Truck Interactions: Lights and high beams, windshield wipers, handbrake, winch operations, CB radio, purchasing parts for customization galore, and more![/list]
Do not have time to play right now? Then we invite you to join our live stream, which will be held as part of the festival!

💬 Share your feedback!

We will be very glad if you decide to share your impressions [url=https://forms.gle/3xCvSWtCBgHqKC25A]in the convenient feedback form[/url], easily accessible in-game. Alternatively, join the conversation [url=https://discord.com/invite/GEV2MrdMzy]on our Discord server[/url], or let us know what you think in the Steam Discussions. Your insight is invaluable!

See you on the road, and let us make some unforgettable memories together!

Yours truly,
Atomic Jelly

notes.title: Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths Dev Diary #90
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Truck Mechanics![/h1] 

Welcome to another exciting developer update. We've got some news about the progress of [b]Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths[/b]. Buckle up and get ready for the latest developments on this wild ride!

[previewyoutube=mrRupL7loJo;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/72c1ae141331ae5741b404005d10400fa6de3391.png[/img]

[h2][b] Desert Map [/b][/h2]
We are pleased to announce the completion of our latest map set in a desert environment. In this map, players will assist with various tasks while helping archaeologists to uncover the history of an ancient civilization and help with desert reforestation. The new map features a range of challenges designed to engage and immerse. We put a lot of effort into its development, and we hope it will make quite an impression on you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/d6834ee72bfeb4a432d1952801e0d9b68e2c26aa.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/72c1ae141331ae5741b404005d10400fa6de3391.png[/img]

[h2][b] Fuel [/b][/h2]
Today, we are introducing a new mechanic to enhance the strategic depth of our game: fuel management. Your trucks will no longer run indefinitely. Keeping an eye on your fuel levels and planning ahead will be essential to ensure you don't run out of fuel mid-route.

Scattered across each map are various refueling stations. You will need to locate and utilize these stations to keep your trucks fueled up and ready for the journey ahead. This adds a new layer of strategy to the game, as you must plan your routes not only for efficiency, but also to ensure you have enough fuel to reach your destination. Fuel involves additional costs, so it will be worthwhile to do additional paid work to balance costs and revenues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/dd540feba649fd47b8a6512ec23bd657abd91a92.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/72c1ae141331ae5741b404005d10400fa6de3391.png[/img]

[h2][b] The day and night cycle [/b][/h2]
We have introduced the full implementation of the day and night cycle in our game. Following the preview in the prologue, this system features daytime followed by nighttime, bringing a dynamic and immersive experience. This new cycle affects visibility and gameplay, requiring players to adapt their strategies and plan their activities according to the time of day. 

In order to facilitate gameplay, we plan to change the functionality of the flashlight and add it permanently to your inventory, in order to make it easier to find your way at night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/4d60d9a92be2415a5e2dc8759eb0596d3f6c26c0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/72c1ae141331ae5741b404005d10400fa6de3391.png[/img]

[h2][b] Additional Missions [/b][/h2]
With all main missions completed, we have started adding extra tasks to the game. These additional challenges provide new objectives and gameplay opportunities, diversifying your experience with various activities and rewards. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/974ead556b8740f7b5a23024abe73e95ddcd7ee4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/72c1ae141331ae5741b404005d10400fa6de3391.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates and keep on trucking! If you like what you see, consider adding Truck Mechanic to your Steam Wishlist!

[h3][b]Add the game to your Steam Wishlist :)[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/995680/Truck_Mechanic_Dangerous_Paths/

[h3][b]JOIN OUR DISCORD COMMUNITY[/b][/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/xhQmGdqBu4]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/5d6362c1cbd78392fa405b5a32687a30f5984fc8.png[/img][/url]

Happy wrenching,
Atomic Jelly

notes.title: Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths Dev Diary #89
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Truck Mechanics![/h1] 

Welcome to another developer post. We got some news about [b]Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths[/b] development process. 


[previewyoutube=R20ifEezgVA;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/72c1ae141331ae5741b404005d10400fa6de3391.png[/img]

[h2][b] Continued work on maps [/b][/h2]
Our most important goal was to comprehensively prepare all the main tasks on the next two maps. As you might have already noticed in the prologue, our approach is quite unique, as most of the tasks, will not involve the truck itself. Your truck will break down as a result of its poor handling, driving on heavy terrain or just random crashes caused by, for example, excessive speed. The tasks are diverse and will be tied together by an interesting storyline.

Each map will have an architectural feature that will stand out strongly. For example, in a map with massive mines, there will be a giant excavator.  On the next one, it will be already mentioned and shown gondola. We don't want to reveal everything, so that you can discover for yourself, and explore the rich world of Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/d20b0c733efd8ad960a353c133cffa25223664ec.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/72c1ae141331ae5741b404005d10400fa6de3391.png[/img]

We have already mentioned this, but we want to highlight it very strongly again. The missions in the game will be diverse and all intertwined with a surprising storyline. We're putting a lot of work into making sure that at every point in the ride you enjoy what you encounter along the way and have a little conundrum about whether you're sure that shortcut you saw on the map is actually still passable and whether it's better to turn around and take a different route.

notes.title: Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths Dev Diary #86
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Truck Mechanics![/h1] 

Welcome to another developer post, we want to assure you that we are working very hard on the game. Each new week brings many changes and improvements. 

[previewyoutube=VT0ZXhDkNe0;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/72c1ae141331ae5741b404005d10400fa6de3391.png[/img]

[h2][b] Side Quests [/b][/h2]
Side missions have been carefully crafted to offer players a range of engaging challenges, Each mission offers unique objectives, ensuring that players are constantly immersed in dynamic gameplay experiences. These will allow you to earn additional funds, which you will allocate, for example, to improve your character's skills or buy more truck customizations. Depending on the area you are in, they will be different. Of course, if you do not want to perform them, no one will force you to do so, however, you will escape quick earnings and opportunities to unlock various surprises. The missions will be divided into those in which you will transport various goods and those in which there will be something to repair.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/f320954feea14478d87f9b4b019894ba73c9cff3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/72c1ae141331ae5741b404005d10400fa6de3391.png[/img]

[h2][b] Even more map improvements [/b][/h2]
We've expanded the game map with new locations, enriching the world of Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths with even more content to explore and discover. New locations are filled with opportunities for adventure and exploring. Players will, uncover secrets, and encounter fresh challenges as they navigate the expanded map. We try to fill all the spaces on the fly, so that everything is coherent and tells an interesting story of the area and the resident population. From caves through buildings, abandoned buildings or even beautiful sinkholes or canyons. All this to make sure that at every step you take while driving through the wilderness, you will find something that can interest you and make you remember.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/23a25a368e75f66bf456d248da4c605017009554.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/72c1ae141331ae5741b404005d10400fa6de3391.png[/img]

[h2][b] Skill tree [/b][/h2]
We're also actively working on updating the talent tree system, introducing new skills and abilities that will allow players to further customize their gameplay experience and tailor their characters to their preferred play style. These perks will provide various benefits - higher earnings from missions, less wear and tear on spare parts, the ability to recover additional parts from repairs, or even reduce damage to the truck while driving like a maniac. We are constantly testing and adapting them to the game, so that they are not too powerful but give significant advantages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/a6286e057490951859e387f0147593542abba7a8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/72c1ae141331ae5741b404005d10400fa6de3391.png[/img]


[h2][b]More immersive world[/b][/h2]
We've taken immersion to the next level by introducing a plethora of new sounds scattered throughout the game maps. As you traverse the dense jungles, prepare to be enveloped by the diverse array of wildlife calls and insect chirps echoing through the foliage. Each rustle of leaves and distant animal call adds to the ambiance, enhancing the sense of realism as you navigate through the vibrant jungle terrain.

Venture into the lofty heights of the mountainous regions, and you'll be greeted by the haunting whispers of the wind as it sweeps through the peaks.  These atmospheric soundscapes transport you to the heart of the wilderness, immersing you in the majesty and grandeur of Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths diverse landscapes.

Furthermore, we've meticulously curated the soundscape of each environment to reflect its unique characteristics and atmosphere. From the tranquil babbling of streams in serene valleys, every sound serves to deepen your connection to the world around you. Whether you're embarking on a perilous journey through dense forests or scaling the towering peaks of mountains.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/9cd2170d00d480183decd05f764079819c14314f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/72c1ae141331ae5741b404005d10400fa6de3391.png[/img]


[h2][b]Mini map[/b][/h2]
The player map interface was update to provide a sleeker and more user-friendly experience. At any point during your gameplay adventure, you can access the updated map with ease. The refreshed design boasts a simple aesthetic and improved clarity, allowing you to navigate the game world with greater precision and efficiency.
